town_description: Kurnool, on the banks of the Tungabhadra in western Andhra Pradesh, is one of the oldest cities of the region — a former capital of Andhra State (1953-1956). It is a pilgrimage hub ringed by major shrines: the Jagannatha Gattu hill temples, Mahanandi, Ahobilam, Srisailam and Mantralayam are all within reach, and the Kondareddy Buruju fort tower stands in the old town.
